label: Total refraining: giving-level refraining versus world-level total noncreation
resolution: 'Could have refrained from creating' has two typed readings here. TOTAL_REFRAINING_1 is giving-level: at some accessible world where the source exists it gives nothing (WithholdsAllAt); it is what a necessarily productive source lacks (omission-scope table). TOTAL_REFRAINING_2 is world-level total noncreation: no concrete being is contingent at the world (NoContingentConcreteIn); it is the content of the GOD_4 total-noncreation power a8dedf3f and of control 2 of the joint-absence scope controls. Neither entails the other without bridges: a source may give only necessary concreta, and contingent concreta may be brute or otherwise caused. No step passes between the senses: the omission table uses sense 1, the 0050b6ed support option uses sense 2, and control 2 of its scope controls states giving-level productivity (NecessarilyGivesSomeAt) separately from the failure of sense 2.
